plan.title: Deft Directive per issue: run an issue on Deft's pipeline, see its state natively, switch back
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

metadata.sizeJustification: Split on 2026-11-02 at the operator's request: this issue keeps the per-issue Deft pipeline core (WI-0 to WI-14, WI-30); the dashboard surfaces WI-15 to WI-29 moved to PAN-4849, blocked by this issue.

narratives.Problem: An operator cannot run a single issue on Deft Directive's own pipeline inside Overdeck. The docs say Overdeck never runs a Deft CLI and does not target 'Full Deft'. A Directive install would land tracked files in the PR, Overdeck would dispatch its own review and test agents, the PR could never reach awaiting merge without an Overdeck approval, and none of Deft's state (scopes, escalations, heartbeats, gates) shows on the dashboard.
narratives.Proposal: Store `pipeline: deft` in the issue override file. `pan skills deft use` installs Directive into that issue's worktree only and hides every change with a worktree-scoped exclude file, skip-worktree flags and a worktree-scoped core.hooksPath, recorded in a snapshot. A lift keeps rebase and sync-main working. Deft issues get Deft's build kickoff, no Overdeck review, test or verification, an approval waiver, a merge guard against deposit paths, drift and a stale state archive in every merge door, and an auto-merge hold when Deft requires a human merge. `pan skills deft back` saves Deft state on the feature branch and undoes the install exactly. A file-only state reader feeds the board, Needs-you, the question dialog, agent tiles, the xBRIEF tab, the DAG, the gates panel, a new Decisions tab with policy, a drift badge, an approved-scope check and finish-loop progress. Full detail: .pan/drafts/PAN-4820.md.
narratives.NonGoals:
- A Deft fork with host-supplied install path or DEFT_ORCHESTRATOR support (Option 2).
- Any contact with upstream deftai (fork-first policy).
- A project-level Deft pipeline default.
- A cross-issue Deft plan graph.
- Remote (Fly) workspaces and polyrepo workspaces in Deft mode.
- Harnesses other than Claude Code and Codex; deterministic menus in the dialog for Codex.
- The dashboard server running any Deft CLI or execSync; it reads Directive files with async fs and writes only escalation resolutions and disposition sign-offs.
- Changing the read-only deft pack's host notice, skill map, or its CLI deny for Overdeck-pipeline issues.
- Merging any Deft install path into the repository.
- Raising any file-size allowlist cap; editing src/cli/commands/start.ts.
- Running Overdeck review, test, or verification agents for a Deft-pipeline issue.
- Using directive uninstall; undo is snapshot-based.

autoDecisions.summary: Install runs via `npx --yes @deftai/directive install --yes --root <worktree>` (plain `directive` when on PATH), 10-minute async timeout, only from `pan skills deft use`, never inside `pan workspace create`.
autoDecisions.rationale: Install needs npm and the network; the workspace-create path has a 60 s timeout. (AD-1, AD-2)

autoDecisions.summary: A Deft issue without a workspace xBRIEF gets a one-item stand-in plan (plan.metadata.deftPlaceholder true) so the existing start checks pass; `back` deletes it.
autoDecisions.rationale: start.ts has 2 lines of file-size room; this avoids editing it. (AD-3)

autoDecisions.summary: Deft issues waive approval at head in the merge gate and derive `ready` without an Overdeck approval; every other merge check still applies.
autoDecisions.rationale: No Overdeck reviewer runs for Deft issues (D6), so nothing would ever approve; the strike-merge waiver is the precedent. (AD-4)

autoDecisions.summary: Overdeck's verification gate is skipped for Deft issues; startRequestReviewPipeline returns early before journaling.
autoDecisions.rationale: Deft's pre-push hook enforces pre-pr:run and CI gates the merge; journaling review.requested would make the Deacon re-request every tick. (AD-5)

autoDecisions.summary: Gate telemetry comes from Deft's run summary (DEFT_RUN_SUMMARY_PATH via a literal allowlist token), not a PostToolUse hook.
autoDecisions.rationale: Deft v0.129.3 installs no PostToolUse hook; the run summary carries per-gate status for Claude Code and Codex. (AD-9)

autoDecisions.summary: Escalation answers rewrite the escalation file in place (status resolved + resolution) atomically, then notify the agent with deliverAgentMessage.
autoDecisions.rationale: Matches deft escalation:resolve semantics without the server running a Deft CLI; the agent polls the file. (AD-10)

autoDecisions.summary: Deterministic menus are parsed from the Claude Code transcript's last assistant text and answered with the exact label; Codex agents keep the plain-text menu in v1.
autoDecisions.rationale: Herdr panes expose no text to the server; the generic answer path wraps answers in Q:/A: prose. (AD-11)

autoDecisions.summary: Acceptance sign-off writes provenance { kind: human-event, actor: overdeck:<operator> } into the scope item's disposition.
autoDecisions.rationale: Deft accepts dispositions only with non-agent provenance; that is a human sign-off in Deft's terms. (AD-12)

autoDecisions.summary: The Deft state archive is written by `pan skills deft save` into .pan/deft/<ISSUE>/{scopes,decisions,approved-scope,escalations}/ on the feature branch; the merge guard refuses a stale archive.
autoDecisions.rationale: D5 requires saving at completion and switch-back; an explicit guarded step avoids Overdeck racing the agent's commits, and the folder names never match the guard's xbrief/ prefix. (AD-13)

autoDecisions.summary: requireHumanMerge: typed boolean wins, malformed → true, absent → autoDeployOnMerge === true, missing file → true; DEFT_ALLOW_BOT_MERGE ignored.
autoDecisions.rationale: D6 says on or unknown ⇒ no auto-merge; Deft's own order applies when the file exists. (AD-15)

autoDecisions.summary: Polyrepo and remote (Fly) workspaces are refused in v1.
autoDecisions.rationale: Issue out-of-scope list; a polyrepo plan home is not the worktree. (AD-16)

autoDecisions.summary: Skip-worktree files and Deft's pre-push hook are lifted around rebaseFeatureBranch and sync-main, with a 3-way git merge-file re-apply.
autoDecisions.rationale: Probed: rebase and merge abort when main changed a skip-worktree file; Overdeck's own pushes would hit Deft's pre-push hook. (AD-7, AD-8)

autoDecisions.summary: One xBRIEF with sizeJustification rather than sibling issues.
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue's acceptance binds every dashboard surface to this issue and auto mode may not re-scope it; the PRD's section 11 names the clean split for the operator. (AD-21)

It refuses only staged or unmerged changes.
